title: NU3 open-chain phosphine <-> 1,2-oxaphosphetane: verified connection

species.name: open-chain phosphine
species.note: user-provided reference minimum inputs/open-freq.out.log E=-496.635832 Ha; the IRC-derived endpoint re-optimizes to a slightly different OH rotamer at E=-496.634711 Ha (+0.70 kcal/mol)

species.name: 1,2-oxaphosphetane ring
species.identity: cyclic 1,2-lambda5-oxaphosphetane, 4-membered P-C-C-O ring, pentacoordinate P with 3 H
species.note: user-provided reference minimum inputs/ring-freq.out.log E=-496.585625 Ha

steps.name: chain-to-ring direct
steps.mechanism: single concerted elementary step; hydroxyl-H migration O->P coupled to P-O ring closure

ts_mode.formula: dominated by the migrating H (atom 7); watch-pair projections O-H 0.969, P-H 0.187, P-O 0.075; heavy-atom displacement fraction 0.004

irc.forward_endpoint: ring minimum (P-O 1.804, H on P, O-H 2.331 A) - lies between TS and B
irc.backward_endpoint: open-chain minimum (P-O 2.520, O-H 1.010, P-H 1.871 A) - lies between TS and A
irc.proof: both IRC endpoint geometries lie between the TS and the corresponding verified endpoint minima; short IRC (forward 20 frames, backward 9 frames) not required to reach the minima

considered_and_rejected.evidence: no betaine stationary point: GFN2-xTB re-optimization of a genuine zwitterion seed collapses to the ring (runs/explore/betaine_guess.out vs B_ring_Aorder.out, E equal to ~0.001 kcal); neither B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP IRC direction passes through a betaine basin. Betaine species and its two candidate steps were removed from the mechanism graph.

history_facts.A_lt_B_given: inputs/open-freq.out.log E=-496.635832; inputs/ring-freq.out.log E=-496.585625; open chain lower by 31.5 kcal/mol

limitations: Single electronic level B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP; electronic barriers only (no ZPE/Gibbs corrections).

Strong method sensitivity for hypervalent P: GFN2/GFN1-xTB place the ring only ~2.6 kcal/mol above the open chain vs +31.5 at B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP; semiempirical numbers must not be quoted as barriers (runs/explore/SUMMARY.md).
IRC was short; endpoint minima were obtained by separate re-optimization/frequency, not by running the IRC to completion.
The IRC-derived open-chain endpoint is a slightly different OH rotamer, +0.70 kcal/mol above the user-provided open-chain minimum; barriers are given both ways.
Gas phase, no solvent/counterion; single conformer per species; no exhaustive conformational search.
mechanism_predict (FlowER) gave a useless 1-species/1-edge network for this hypervalent-P transformation and was not used as evidence.
